strategy_goal: Build distinct source-preserving channel franchises around competitor-supported viewer demand, then validate them with comparable audience data; topic_mix remains candidate-scouting input until source and audience gates pass.

channels.name: ChonkerTalks Россия
channels.niche_label: Russian Reddit Stories: SAGA + BUNDLE + THREAD
channels.viewer_promise: Самые захватывающие истории и обсуждения Reddit на русском: конкретный конфликт или необъяснимый случай, эскалация и полноценная развязка без выдуманных продолжений.
forbidden_bets: generic awkward or embarrassing lists without a reveal and fallout
factual claim based only on Reddit
channels.evidence_policy: Preserve Reddit provenance and meaning. Label r/nosleep as fiction and other personal accounts as unverified; never present a Reddit-only claim as independently confirmed fact.
channels.render_contract: Use acc1_format_visual_system_v3 for every new long episode. BUNDLE is a sequence of separate mini-comics with isolated casts, SAGA is one continuous recurring-cast story, and THREAD is one prompt plus 13-15 visually distinct responses distributed across 16-20 meaning-led comic page packs with deterministic question/answer labels and the female comment voice. HyperFrames must render in bounded segments no longer than 120 seconds. The copper Chonker is limited to brand intro, CTA and outro; no fictional-as-real framing.

producer_brief.must_feel_like: specific, emotionally legible, easy to package in one sentence, complete, and worth discussing after the ending
producer_brief.winning_bets: AITA-style relationship and family conflict, work and justice, secrets with reveal and fallout, matrix glitches, time slips, impossible coincidences, and strange or dark incidents with a clear payoff
producer_brief.weak_topic_traps: generic confession, awkward or embarrassing lists, one-sided low-stakes complaints, incomplete updates, missing screenshots, raw links, dry trivia, politics, and stories whose appeal disappears in Russian

content_pillars.label: Сбои матрицы, странное, тёмное и необъяснимое

pilot_matrix.packaging_rule: one concrete family or relationship conflict, visible opposing sides, and a source-backed reversal or payoff
one concrete workplace or money injustice, clear escalation, and a source-backed consequence
one impossible or frightening incident with escalating source-backed resolution and an explicit fiction or unverified-account label
secrets and confessions only when the prompt asks for discovery, reveal, consequences, or aftermath; generic awkward lists are excluded
search_queries: "family secret" AND (discovered OR revealed OR exposed OR "found out")
"dark secret" AND (discovered OR revealed OR exposed OR "found out")
confession AND (aftermath OR fallout OR consequences OR changed)
(secret OR confession) AND (discovered OR revealed OR exposed) AND (story OR experience OR happened)

pilot_matrix.packaging_rule: unusual insider experiences with concrete narrative consequences; keep outside the core mix until comparable audience data exists
search_queries: job AND (incident OR experience OR happened) AND (after OR changed OR learned)
workplace AND (incident OR story OR experience) AND (consequence OR aftermath OR changed)
profession AND (unusual OR strangest OR worst) AND (experience OR happened)
career AND (incident OR experience OR happened) AND (learned OR changed)

pilot_matrix.packaging_rule: glitches in reality, time slips, impossible coincidences, or unexplained incidents with narrative detail and aftermath
search_queries: "glitch in the matrix" AND (story OR experience OR happened)
"glitch in reality" AND (story OR experience OR happened)
("time slip" OR "lost time" OR "time loop") AND (story OR experience OR happened)
("impossible coincidence" OR unexplained) AND (incident OR event OR experience OR happened)

channel_branding.proposed_description:
Самые захватывающие истории и обсуждения Reddit на русском.

AITA и семейные конфликты, работа и справедливость, тайны с последствиями, сбои матрицы и странные необъяснимые случаи. Мы сохраняем смысл оригинальных постов, читаем апдейты и лучшие комментарии — без выдуманных продолжений и лишней воды.

Три формата: подборки законченных историй, одна большая сага и тематические треды ответов Reddit.

Личные рассказы пользователей не подтверждены независимо. Истории из r/nosleep — художественная выдумка.

channels.translate_prompt: Переведи на русский язык, сохранив разговорный стиль и эмоции оригинала. Адаптируй сленг Reddit под молодёжную речь.

channels.name: ChonkerTalks
channels.viewer_promise: The hidden story behind the internet's strangest moments: what happened, why people cared, and what changed.
forbidden_bets: creator allegation based only on Reddit
channels.evidence_policy: Internet and creator claims require primary or independent corroboration; Reddit may be a discovery lead, not the factual source.
channels.render_contract: Evidence dossier with timeline and original producer take; generic translated Reddit-card readings are off-promise.

producer_brief.must_feel_like: high-concept, instantly clear, specific, and meaningfully more useful than the source post
producer_brief.winning_bets: internet mysteries, creator-community conflicts, bizarre systems, and surprising consequences with a clean timeline
producer_brief.weak_topic_traps: generic Reddit reads, saturated AITA tropes, fandom minutiae, and link-dependent questions

forbidden_bets: OutOfTheLoop question used as an answer
